A '''persona''' is the set of all versions of one character. No more than one version of the same unique persona may be on table at a time.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref> The persona mechanic was introduced in [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]], for example [[Commander Luke Skywalker]] and [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

Cards that refer to "Luke" apply to any version of the Luke persona (Luke Skywalker, Commander Luke Skywalker, Son of Skywalker and so on); "Chewbacca" and "Chewie" are interchangeable.<ref name="gl20" /> If a unique card is sent back to hand, another card of the same persona with a different title may still be deployed that turn.<ref name="gl20" />
